gallery.filename: Actividades conmemorativas de las Instrucciones Año XIII 17.jpg
gallery.title: File:Actividades conmemorativas de las Instrucciones Año XIII 17.jpg
gallery.source: Actividades conmemorativas de las Instrucciones Año XIII 17
gallery.description:
On April 3rd 2011,the Opening Ceremony of the XIII Year Celebrations were held in Uruguay. The event was part of the activities commemorating the Bicentennial of Uruguay, which took place during that year. A ceremony that took place in Montevideo and was attended by more than 500 children from 19 schools across the country.
This photograph was taken by the Secretariat Santiago Barreiro of the Bicentennial Commission, which is made ​​up of authorities of all political parties, from different ministries and agencies of the Government of Uruguay.
